text.moon: T-minus 3 days, Commander. Your crew launches for the Moon's south pole. Time to get the ship ready.
text.mars: T-minus 3 days, Commander. Your crew launches for Mars, a seven-month trip. Time to get the ship ready.

fact.moon: The Moon is about 384,400 km from Earth. A crew capsule needs around 3 to 4 days to fly there.
fact.mars: Launch windows to Mars open only about every 26 months, when Earth and Mars line up well.

nodes.speaker: eng
nodes.text: Frost is forming on a fuel line. Super-cold fuel does that, but frost can also hide a leak.
nodes.fact: Liquid oxygen rocket fuel is about -183°C, so water vapor from the air freezes onto the outside of the pipes.
